action.description: What to do (default: summary). Status-as-action (tested_vulnerable etc.) implies mark; 'mark' takes an explicit status= argument. 'untested' lists priority gaps, 'gate' reads the completion gate, 'note' records a wide/local note.

vuln_class.description: The class being marked (for tested/not_applicable actions)

evidence.description: Evidence for the marking — REQUIRED for tested_not_vulnerable (≥30 chars + request_sent) and for not_applicable on high-weight classes (≥50 chars: why the class cannot exist here)

request_sent.description: The verb/command actually fired (required for tested_not_vulnerable)
